parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type INHIBITOR. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type equals INHIBITOR. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
